snippet.title: Luigi Fiano - Digital Growth Academy
snippet.description:
They replaced me with AI. No warning. Seven years at that company, a team of twenty under me, a salary I was proud of. Then one morning a piece of software was doing my job, and I wasn't needed anymore.

I could've spent months being angry about it. Instead I got curious. If AI was good enough to replace a manager, what could it do if it worked for me?

Turns out, a lot. I built a six-figure business in Europe from my kitchen table, working a few hours a month.
Now I want to see if I can do it again somewhere I have zero advantage. So I'm starting over in the US. No followers, no shortcuts, nothing hidden. Just me trying to get this thing to $100K a month, and filming the whole thing as it happens.
If you've ever felt the ground move under your career, you'll probably get why I'm doing this. Stick around and figure it out with me.

New videos every week.

Luigi
